text:
marta: Heads-up — drafting release notes for 3.0.0 (major runtime deploy: quantized kernels + routing resilience). Need docs/ops/legal review by EOD PT so I can pin and schedule the deploy. Pin target: 2025-01-10 15:00 PT. Deploy window: 2025-01-11 03:00-07:00 UTC. Any regional embargoes (APAC/EU) we should call out?
jen: Docs: please include a short "breaking changes" line calling out the default for `truncate` flips to true for compact models, and include a curl example. Also prefer the phrase "version pin (artifact SHA)" in user-facing text.
priya: Comms: plan to auto-post internal announcement when canary reaches 25%. Will prepare localized one-liners for APAC/EU and include an ops bullet on who to ping. Confirm annotation key we expect from deploybot for autopost.
sam: Ops asks: add explicit rollback criteria and the exact revert tag. Propose: rollback if client error rate delta > 1.8% sustained for 8m OR p95 token latency increases by > 220ms sustained for 10m. Revert tag: "hotfix/revert-3.0.0". Include step-by-step revert commands in the runbook.
alvin: I can run the smoke across US+EU. I suggest smoke checklist: health endpoints, 5 gen prompts (varied lengths), 3 embeddings, KV warming, routing fallback test to regional variant. Ill post logs here. If routing fallback fails in EU, I will hit revert and escalate.
legal-bot: NOTE: Quick legal skim requested for APAC data residency language. If customers in Japan/SGO require review, ping legal-private for a 2-hour review SLA.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan staged: 2% -> 25% -> 70% -> 100% with 12m ramps. Auto-rollback if canary error rate delta > 1.3% OR p95 latency delta > 180ms vs baseline. Command preview: `/deploy start v3.0.0 --canary=2,25,70 --ramp=12m --annotations="comms:autopost,ops-runbook:attached"`
marta: Added revert tag and rollback criteria to draft, plus Dedicated FAQ blurb about quiesce and pinned artifact behavior (example: pinned artifact sha: abc1234def). Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/3.0.0-draft — please comment inline. Also added a one-line security note for legal to eyeball.
jen: Pushed curl snippet to the draft:
``
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-3","input":"status?","truncate":true}'
```
And a small compatibility note.
priya: Ill own the internal-announce template. Plan: autopost to `internal-announce` at 25% canary (deploybot will attach). Manual follow-up at 70% if everything looks green. Ill attach the ops runbook snippet and who to ping (ops-rotation, eng-oncall, legal-private).
alvin: Smoke readiness approved. Ill run EU tests focusing on routing fallback and post results. Rollback procedure acknowledged.
sam: Added a short paragraph for Dedicated customers about scheduled quiesce (expected 5-10m interruption for model swap) and instructions to request a maintenance freeze.
marta: If no objections I will pin the draft at 2025-01-10 15:00 PT and flip the deploybot annotation to `comms:autopost` so the internal announcement posts automatically at canary 25%. Please thumps-up here once reviewed.
jen: \ud83d\udc4d docs sign-off (tiny wording tweak).
priya: \ud83d\udc4d comms sign-off, will post localized APAC/EU lines after pin.
alvin: \ud83d\udc4d ready to run smoke.
sam: \ud83d\udc4d ops sign-off.
marta: Pinned. Deploybot annotation will be set to `comms:autopost` when we flip the flag prior to start. Reminder to show UTC + PT in pinned blurb and include the Dedicated FAQ link.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2025-01-11T03:00:00Z. Release artifact `manifest-3.0.0.json` attached. Canary annotations set to trigger `internal-announce` at 25% step.
marta: Thanks team — Ill post the pinned link and monitor the canary steps. If smoke shows issues, alvin/sam will trigger "hotfix/revert-3.0.0" and broadcast to ops-rotation.
